extracted.name: Creole Broiled Catfish
extracted.description: Skip frying and use this easy broiled recipe to prepare Creole-seasoned catfish instead for your next main seafood dish.
instruction_lines: Gather ingredients. Position a rack 5 inches below the heating element of an oven and preheat the broiler to high.
Rinse the fish fillets under cold running water and pat them dry. Brush both sides with oil and arrange them in a single layer on a broiler pan lined with aluminum foil.
Mix together the seasoned pepper, garlic powder, and seasoned salt in a small bowl. Sprinkle half of the spice mixture over one side of the fish.
Using a spatula, carefully turn the fish over. Sprinkle with the remaining spice mixture. Continue broiling until the fish is opaque in the center, 3 to 5 minutes more.
